SELECT w.status, w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL no_dispatch, count(distinct w.web_order_id) orders, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net,
 min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25') OR f.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-05-31'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, p.subcategory, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN n.net_sales END) AS of_which_outdoor_lighting
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.category_as_was = 'Garden' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'version_mismatch_garden_lines' k, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) v
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.category='Garden' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-05-05' AND NOT (f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'neg_or_zero_qty_or_net', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.category='Garden' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND (f.quantity<=0 OR f.net_amount<=0)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'max_line_net', count(*), max(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.category='Garden' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'garden_lines_sold_after_delist', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.category='Garden' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND p.delisted_on IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date > p.delisted_on
UNION ALL
SELECT 'garden_lines_before_listed', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.category='Garden' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND f.sale_date < p.listed_from
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_garden_fy', count(*), sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE p.category='Garden' AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return_before_sale', count(*), sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE r.return_date < f.sale_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'net_vs_gross_mismatch', count(*), sum(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE p.category='Garden' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-10-28' AND '2025-04-27' AND abs(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)-f.gross_amount)>0.02

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(net_sales) v FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1),
ctrl AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND r.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.v, c.c, m.v-c.c gap FROM mine m JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n.cat_was='Garden' THEN n.net_sales END) AS as_was,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cp.category='Garden' THEN n.net_sales END) AS as_is
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
